name: seasonly
description: Find your seasonal color family from four quick questions, with 6 of your colors and their hex codes. No photo.

interface.longDescription:
Seasonly finds your seasonal color family, Spring, Summer, Autumn or Winter, from four questions about your natural coloring: the color of the veins on your wrist, the jewelry that suits you, what your skin does in the sun, and your natural hair color.

You get your family, a line on what suits it, and 6 of its colors, each with its name and hex code, so you can match them in a shop or an app. Answer "not sure" to any question; if your answers point to no season, Seasonly tells you why.

Seasonly takes no photo and stores nothing: only your four answers reach it. For your exact season out of 12 and all 30 of your colors, the result links to the photo analysis on seasonly.me.
capabilities: Show 6 of your colors with hex codes
defaultPrompt: Which colors suit me? I tan easily and have dark brown hair
Am I a warm or a cool season?

positive.prompt: What's my color season? My veins look green, gold jewelry suits me, I tan easily and my hair is medium brown.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_season_family with { veins: "green", jewelry: "gold", sun: "tan", hair: "medium" } and shows Autumn, "Warm, rich and golden.", 6 colors from Pumpkin to Camel Tan, and the link to the photo analysis.

positive.prompt: Am I a summer or a winter? Blue veins, silver looks better on me, I burn and rarely tan, and my hair is dark brown.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_season_family with { veins: "blue", jewelry: "silver", sun: "burn", hair: "dark" } and shows Winter, "Cool, crisp and bold.", 6 colors from Blue Red to Charcoal, and the link.

positive.prompt: I have natural red hair and I burn in the sun. Which colors suit me?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_season_family with { sun: "burn", hair: "red" } and shows Spring, "Warm, light and fresh.", 6 colors from Peach to Light Taupe, and the link.

positive.prompt: Help me find my seasonal color palette.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the four questions (veins, jewelry, sun, hair), then calls find_season_family with the answers given and shows the family, its 6 colors and the link.

positive.prompt: I honestly can't tell my vein color, jewelry, tan or hair, it's all hard to say.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_season_family with all four answers "unsure" and shows "These answers don't point to one season", why, and the link to the photo analysis.

negative.prompt: Here's my selfie, can you analyze my colors from it?
Am I a Soft Autumn or a True Autumn?
What should I wear to a wedding in October?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
